name: AP_IDR_OPTION_EXTENSIONS_
description: AP_IDR_OPTION_EXTENSIONS table contains information about additional configuration options listed under  the IDR Option Extensions of the Manage Intelligent Document Recognition Options task AP_IDR_OPTION_EXTENSIONS_ is the Audit table for it.

columns.name: OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the store option code. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_AP_IDR_OPTION_EXTENSIONS and ORA_AP_IDR_OPTION_EXTENSIONS_V.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG

columns.name: OPTION_VALUE
columns.description: Store  value provided in the option.
